question: Maulana Azad National Urdu University (MANUU) is a Central University established at National Level in ____ by an act of Parliament.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1998.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Maulana Azad National Urdu University (MANUU)** was **established by an Act of Parliament in 1998.**
 
• It is a** central university located in Hyderabad**, Telangana.
 
• It was named after Maulana Abul Kalam Azad, who was a freedom fighter, an educationist, and the first Education Minister of independent India.
 
• The university is **known for promoting Urdu **language and literature.
 
• It has a dedicated Department of Urdu, which offers courses in Urdu language, literature, and culture.
 
• It has campuses in Hyderabad, Lucknow, and Srinagar.
 
• It also has centers in various cities across India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Maulana Abul Kalam Azad:**

 
• He was the **nation's first minister **of education from 1948 to 1958.
 
• He **led the Khilafat movement **from the front.
 
• He chose the pen name "Azad," which means "freedom," in order to distance himself from dogmatic religious beliefs.
 
• He **fought for children's right to free education **until the age of fourteen.
 
• He was also a pioneer in the establishment of India's higher education board, the University Grants Commission.
